title: kate-core: rank candidates by fuzzy score
summary: fuzzy_rank scores every candidate with fuzzy_match, drops the ones that do not match, and returns the best first with the candidate index. Equal scores keep the candidate order. limit caps the result. Quick open and the command palette rank their rows with it.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The crate is pure Rust and builds anywhere. The backlog marks this title LOCAL so the Mac lane keeps the panes and their models together.

definitions.definition:
/// (candidate index, hit) pairs sorted by score, highest first, stable on ties. At most `limit` entries.
pub fn fuzzy_rank(pattern: &str, candidates: &[&str], limit: usize) -> Vec<(usize, FuzzyHit)>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Collect (index, hit) for each candidate where fuzzy_match is Some, sort with sort_by_key on the negated score, which is stable, and truncate to limit. limit 0 gives an empty Vec. An empty pattern keeps every candidate in order with score 0. fuzzy_rank is pub in fuzzy.rs and carries #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))] until the next packet exports it from lib.rs. The test fuzzy_rank_orders_by_score ranks pattern ab over [xaxb, ab, ba, abc] and asserts the first index is 1, the result has three entries, and index 2 is absent. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because fuzzy_rank does not exist. After the change the exact candidate ranks first, a non-match is dropped, and ties keep their order.
